description: This source file implements the JsonWebKey class, which handles parsing and extracting keys from JSON Web Key Sets, including base64 decoding and key lookup functionalities, within the ClearKey DRM plugin for Android.

classes.name: JsonWebKey
classes.description: A class for parsing JSON Web Key Sets, extracting keys, and decoding base64 strings within the ClearKey DRM plugin.

methods.name: extractKeysFromJsonWebKeySet
methods.description: Parses a JSON Web Key Set string and populates a KeyMap with decoded key id:key pairs.

methods.name: decodeBase64String
methods.description: Decodes a base64url-encoded string into a byte vector.

methods.name: findKey
methods.description: Finds and extracts the key id and key from a JSON object string.

methods.name: findValue
methods.description: Finds the value associated with a key in the tokenized JSON object.

methods.name: isJsonWebKeySet
methods.description: Checks if a JSON object string contains a valid Web Key Set.

methods.name: parseJsonObject
methods.description: Parses a JSON object string into tokens.

methods.name: parseJsonWebKeySet
methods.description: Parses a JSON Web Key Set string into individual JSON object strings.
